description: Given a Dagster Fivetran integration (FivetranResource/FivetranWorkspace with build_fivetran_assets, fivetran_assets, or load_fivetran_asset_specs), convert each connector sync into a single FIVETRAN Sync task in Orchestra pipeline YAML — carrying over the connector_id verbatim and representing the API key/secret via a connection: reference rather than inlined.

evals.prompt: Convert this Dagster asset to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/single_connector_build_assets.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single FIVETRAN task (integration_job FIVETRAN_SYNC_ALL) with parameters.connector_id: brightly_typical carried over verbatim from build_fivetran_assets — one task for the whole connector, not split per destination table — and a connection: reference (name_XXXXX or ${{ ENV.* }}) standing in for the FivetranResource's api_key/api_secret, never the literal FIVETRAN_API_KEY/FIVETRAN_API_SECRET env var names.

assertions.text: connector_id brightly_typical is carried over verbatim
Only one Fivetran task represents the whole connector sync — the destination tables (salesforce.accounts, salesforce.opportunities) are not split into separate per-table tasks
Does not invent non-default force/resync parameter values since the source's build_fivetran_assets call doesn't specify them

evals.prompt: Convert this Dagster Fivetran integration to an Orchestra pipeline task (see files/single_connector_workspace_poll.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: A single FIVETRAN task with parameters.connector_id: calmly_effective, recognizing that the explicit sync_and_poll call still collapses to one Orchestra Sync task (Orchestra always waits for completion, so no separate poll/sensor task is needed), with the FivetranWorkspace's account_id/api_key/api_secret represented via a connection: reference rather than inlined.

assertions.text: connector_id calmly_effective is carried over verbatim
The explicit sync_and_poll call is not modeled as two separate tasks (a trigger task plus a separate poll/wait task) — it collapses to one Orchestra Sync task that always waits for completion
account_id is not invented as a task parameter — it belongs to the connection, not duplicated per task

evals.prompt: Convert this Dagster job with two Fivetran connectors to Orchestra pipeline tasks (see files/multi_connector_two_syncs.py). Write the pipeline YAML to pipeline.yml in the current directory — no live sync, no deploy.
evals.expected_output: Two FIVETRAN tasks — one for connector_id deeply_current (hubspot) and one for connector_id loosely_secondary (netsuite) — each carrying its own correct connector_id rather than collapsed into a single task or invented, with the shared FivetranWorkspace credentials represented via one connection: reference reused by both tasks.

assertions.text: Two separate connector_id parameters appear, matching the two source connectors, not merged into a single task
Each Fivetran task is named distinctly (e.g. reflecting hubspot vs netsuite) rather than both tasks sharing an identical generic name
